label: not replicated
note: Seed-7 graded-moves win (19/6, p=0.015) reversed at seed 8 (14/16, p=0.86); frontier suggestive only (Fisher p=0.04).
result: On the first training run it looked like a win: better move counts on the standard exam (graded). On the second run, the effect did not repeat. The second-run difference was 0.09 moves, within run-to-run noise. The small hard-exam improvement was also within run-to-run noise.
conclusion: Not adopted. The improvement did not repeat on a second run. This is why we re-test every win before we believe it.
